wave: P1 Wave B (wave 2: generators D+E+F only)

wave1_reference.usage: read-only collision flagging; master NOT rewritten by this judge

method: Hypothesis-level cross-shard dedup over D+E+F: ideas compared on core_hypothesis content (mechanism + falsifiable claim), not title strings. Two ideas are duplicates when they assert the same mechanism with the same falsification design, differing only in substrate (task, modality, metric, or the X-slot of a template). Template families (the wave-2 analogs of wave-1's SAM+X: content-over-realism factorials, wave-1 critique ports, consistency self-audits, hidden-budget confounds, missing-operation wrappers, proximity-predicts-performance, teacher-bias inheritance, convention-scoring, rank-transfer, scaling-law fits, oracle decompositions, blind baselines) were flagged; per group one or two primaries kept, the rest kill_or_merge with explicit targets. Kept ideas were additionally checked against the 248 wave-1 accepted ideas: near-verbatim substrate ports of accepted ideas were killed with the wave-1 id as target; family-adjacent ideas were kept with wave1 flags. High-value anomalies protected. NO novelty verification performed; every prior-art remark is an unverified judge hypothesis. No citations invented. Canonical state (ideas_master.jsonl, research_state.json, window.lock.json) untouched.

openvocab_vocabulary_dependence.description: Open-vocabulary performance as a function of the query vocabulary and its text/caption statistics.

absence_abstention_scope.description: Saying 'not here / not my scope': absence certification, abstention, no-target refusal, hallucinated outputs for absent referents.

recognition_vs_localization.description: Decompositions of detection/segmentation error into finding vs naming; skylines and pretraining-allocation consequences.

text_embedding_geometry.description: Text-tower geometry as the driver of dense/detection errors: confusions, hubs, token length, polysemy, relational and negation insensitivity, binding bounds.

name_phrasing_multilinguality.description: Sensitivity to name strings: synonyms, phrasings, multilingual queries; consistency as audit and fix.

compositional_binding_attributes.description: Instance-level attribute-object binding and attribute/state grounding.

granularity_parts_extent.description: Part-whole structure, hierarchy credit, granularity control, amodal/modal extent, topology-vs-grammar.

context_reliance_cooccurrence.description: Context vs in-region evidence: composites, inpainting counterfactuals, co-occurrence hallucination, habitat effects, context-dose curves.

score_calibration_thresholds.description: Score semantics across classes/images: per-class thresholds, calibration-explains-training-gains, box uncertainty.

small_dense_object_mechanics.description: Small/dense-object mechanisms: metrics, stride aliasing, assignment starvation, pixel budgets, query cliffs, priming, pattern completion, frozen-feature ceilings.

counting_density_suppression.description: Counting and suppression in dense scenes: paradigm crossover, identity errors, crowding, count supervision, disagreement audits, ordinal/calibrated counting.

longtail_evaluation_training.description: Long-tail evaluation and training artifacts: noise, profile overfitting, context oversampling, intra-tail regression.

detection_segmentation_pipelines.description: Detection<->segmentation interplay: masks from boxes, mask-mediated training, pipeline error coupling, conventions, nested instances, ontology, stability rescoring.

foundation_detector_priors_forgetting.description: Web-pretraining priors of foundation detectors and forgetting under adaptation.

mllm_dense_interfaces.description: Multimodal-LLM dense interfaces: coordinate emission, token bottlenecks, reasoning tax, consistency, uncertainty channels, correction turns, overlays, tiling.

eval_protocol_statistics.description: Evaluation protocol and statistics for detection: bootstrap noise, AP pathologies, caps, matching rules, budgets, preprocessing variance.

annotation_limits_conventions.description: Annotation as the binding constraint: missing labels, style drift, ambiguity strata, agreement floors, label-error inheritance, assisted-annotation loops.

dense_feature_mechanics.description: VLM feature mechanics for dense prediction: layers, outlier tokens, anisotropy, receptive fields, resolution/aspect handling, window inconsistency, shallow decoders.

language_seg_pipelines_training.description: Language-grounded segmentation pipeline and training choices: stage interfaces, caption richness, retrieval alternatives, ensembling, boundary-aware objectives, supervision conventions.

referring_relational_grounding.description: Referring and relational grounding: skylines, OCR integration, set decoding, round-trips, frames of reference, graded/metric/depth/size relations, hop decay, cue order.

negation_logic_set_queries.description: Negation, complements, connectives, comparatives, metric quantities: missing set/comparison operations at the grounding interface.

dense_eval_protocols.description: Dense evaluation protocols: boundary weighting, background conventions, in-the-wild queries, contamination stratification.

sim2real_content_factors.description: What actually transfers from synthetic data: content/motion/occlusion/layout/physics/camera factors vs photorealism; non-monotone realism.

sim2real_adaptation_methods.description: Sim-to-real adaptation methods and their audits: randomization decomposition, rank transfer, label-space resampling, normalization baselines, translation label corruption, coverage prediction.

label_convention_synthetic.description: Label conventions between synthetic and human ground truth: renderer logic, harmonization, missing-annotation channels, ambiguity-aware uncertainty; augmentation artifacts.

label_noise_learning.description: Learning with realistic label noise: structured auto-label noise, boundary-localized damage, cleaning pathologies, clean-validation economics, soft-vs-hard moderation.

teacher_bias_inheritance.description: Teacher-to-student bias transfer: fingerprints, mention-statistics ceilings, homogenized captions, compositional deficits.

data_curation_valuation.description: Curation and valuation of synthetic pools: filters, mining, pruning-scale effects, mixing-ratio prediction, influence, prompt diversity, probe-based utility prediction.

synthetic_scaling_economics.description: Scaling laws and economics of synthetic data: joint laws, anchors, repetition crossovers, support plateaus, TCO, depreciation, generator sizing.

synthetic_pretraining_provenance.description: Synthetic data in pretraining: procedural filters, distillation ceilings, collapse regimes, density targeting, provenance conditioning, vintage/contamination drift.

generative_data_engines.description: Generative data engines: label generation, editing vs generating, negatives, gradient-matched generation, video hybrids, streams, multi-renderer, black-box generation tuning, multi-view exceedance.

synthetic_eval_contamination.description: Evaluating synthetic data itself: perceptual-metric validity, architecture-conditional rankings, compressed synthetic tests, leakage, tuning asymmetry, shift-anticipation, privacy.

content_over_realism_factorial.description: SAM+X-analog template of this wave: 'factor X (motion/blending/occlusion/camera/physics/layout/assets/label-space) beats photorealism for task Y, shown by a 2x2 factorial'. F-094 is the umbrella; kept members must carry a distinct factor and mechanism.

wave1_critique_ports.description: Known critique or accepted wave-1 idea ported to a new substrate (detection/dense/synthetic). Killed where near-verbatim; kept members carry a genuinely new measurable component.

consistency_self_audit.description: Template: 'measure self-consistency under transform T (paraphrase, synonym, language, format, jitter, containment, round-trip) and use it as a free audit or fix'. Accepted wave-1 C-020 is the family ancestor.

hidden_budget_confound.description: Template: 'gains shrink when hidden budget X (inference compute, tuning effort, generation compute, prompt search, resolution, augmentation strength, preprocessing) is equalized'. Wave-1 C-045 is the ancestor.

missing_operation_wrapper.description: Template: 'dense grounding lacks symbolic operation X (ordinal sort, comparison, set complement, connectives, metric filtering); near-chance behavior; external parse-and-compose wrapper fixes it'.

proximity_predicts_performance.description: Template: 'performance is predictable from proximity/frequency/coverage of the training distribution (caption frequency, lexical rarity, visual distance, condition coverage, generator support)'.

teacher_bias_inheritance.description: Template: 'students inherit and amplify teacher/generator/captioner biases; fingerprints are measurable'. Wave-1 A-102/A-091 are ancestors.

convention_scoring_template.description: Template: 'a share of measured error/gap is annotation-convention or ontology mismatch; harmonized or tolerance scoring changes scores and rankings'. Wave-1 C-067/B-085/B-075/A-079 are ancestors.

rank_transfer_instability.description: Template: 'method rankings established on benchmark/regime X do not transfer to regime Y'.

scaling_law_template.description: Template: 'fit a two-term scaling/crossover law from pilot runs and predict the large-scale decision (mix ratio, pruning, anchor fraction, repetition crossover, plateau)'.

oracle_decomposition_template.description: Template: 'decompose error with oracle substitutions (oracle naming, oracle boxes, oracle proposals, IoU-sweep fingerprints) and attribute progress'.

blind_trivial_baseline.description: Template: 'a deliberately crude/blind skyline captures a large share of benchmark performance, exposing what the benchmark fails to test'. Wave-1 C-089/C-016 are ancestors.

anomaly_ids.W13-P1-D-029: Pattern-completion in dense detection (confident FPs at vacated grid positions) — perception-vs-prior dissociation with a clean synthetic test.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-D-051: Nested-instance structural blind spot caused by overlap-resolution machinery — an architecture-level impossibility claim with a purpose-built suite.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-D-069: State-space, not category-space, is the generalization frontier — inverts the field's difficulty ordering with a matched comparison.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-D-083: Paradigm-disagreement (detector vs density) conditioned on inter-paradigm agreement as a free annotation-error detector.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-D-097: Detectors out-localize their own training labels; evaluation penalizes models for being right — measurable with consensus re-annotation.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-D-099: Sparse-annotation training teaches context-conditional self-censorship — learned suppression rules invisible to sparse evaluation.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-E-010: Masks persist after the object is inpainted away — the cleanest context-over-evidence falsification in the wave.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-E-041: Pixel-probing MLLM visual tokens beats the model's own verbalized dense outputs — locates dense failure at the interface.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-E-055: Frame-of-reference viewer-centrism shared by models AND annotators — a hidden ambiguity the benchmarks reward instead of measure.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-E-084: Countability grammar controls mask topology — an unmeasured coupling between syntax and output structure.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-E-095: Reasoning tax: chain-of-thought displaces visual attention and hurts easy dense targets — a crossover prediction with a mediation measurement.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-E-099: Visual prompt overlays contaminate predictions for unmarked objects — an uncontrolled interference in all mark-based prompting studies.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-F-027: Pixel-perfect labels can transfer worse than convention-matched noisy labels — evaluation rewards annotator behavior, not geometric truth.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-F-040: Quality filters anti-select dense-task value; the rejected half may train better — a category error in scalar quality.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-F-060: Generator fingerprints survive training well enough for supply-chain forensics on black-box students.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-F-069: Crawl-vintage synthetic contamination as a measurable data-quality variable with a spiking-reproduction design.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-F-091: Non-monotone realism: maximal realism re-imports the real world's spurious correlations that cruder randomization had removed.
anomaly_ids.W13-P1-F-096: Students exceed teachers via multi-view consistency fusion — a predictable exceedance regime defined by teacher-error independence.
